info.title: Stakeflow API
info.summary: Norwegian Continental Shelf production, attributed to the companies that own it.
info.description: Source: Sodir (Norwegian Offshore Directorate), Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD). Volumes are monthly Sm³ oil equivalent unless the field name says otherwise. Equinor figures cover the Norwegian shelf only. Prices: EIA (public domain), ECB, World Bank (CC BY 4.0); share prices only where imported locally. Scenarios are what-ifs, not forecasts. Not investment advice.

post.description:
Claude writes one read-only SQL query for the question, the API validates and runs it,
and Claude explains the rows. Numbers in the answer come from the rows, never the model.

503.description: Ask is off or cannot run: no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (code llm_not_configured), no reader role password (reader_not_configured), the model or database cannot be reached (llm_unavailable, reader_unavailable) or no data is loaded (no_data).

post.description:
Translate a what-if case ("What if Johan Sverdrup stops for two months and oil goes to
$90?") into scenario parameters.

Claude only reports what the text says; every number is computed here from the marts and the
reference levels you send, range-checked and explained in `assumptions`. Snake_case on
purpose: this is the scenario model's parameter contract.

422.description: The text could not be turned into scenario parameters

get.description:
36 months of p10 / p50 / p90 (Sm³ o.e. per month) and the model card.

The first point repeats the last actual month so a chart line continues from history.
Shut-down fields return their model card with no points.
Newest live prediction per focus company, for the latest quarter predicted (kboe/d).
The prediction log: every live and backtest prediction, actuals, errors and hashes.

get.description:
How the share price *might* respond to the changes you pick, with an 80% band.

A scenario, not a forecast; not investment advice. The query parameters are the shared
scenario contract: brent_change_pct, ttf_change_pct, production_change_pct,
eurusd_change_pct, horizon_months.
Flagged months of the latest run (last 24 months), newest and largest first.
When the latest run happened, what it looked at, and how it decides.

BacktestQuarter.title: BacktestQuarter
BacktestQuarter.description: Quarterly share return, actual vs explained by the drivers (in %).

ForecastPoint.title: ForecastPoint
ForecastPoint.description: One month, Sm³ o.e. p10 is the low case, p90 the high (80% range).

licence.title: Licence
licence.default: Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD)

LatestPrices.title: LatestPrices
LatestPrices.description:
Newest spot values, in the field names of the frontend's ForwardPrices.

These are spot (last observation), not forward prices: no free source with display rights
publishes Brent or TTF forwards.

initialDeclinePctPerYear.title: Initialdeclinepctperyear
initialDeclinePctPerYear.description: Effective decline over the first year of the fitted curve, percent.

backtestErrorPct.title: Backtesterrorpct
backtestErrorPct.description: Mean absolute % error over the 12 held-out months.

naiveErrorPct.title: Naiveerrorpct
naiveErrorPct.description: Same, for the last 3 months held flat.

backtestCoveragePct.title: Backtestcoveragepct
backtestCoveragePct.description: Share of held-out months inside the 80% range.

Nowcast.title: Nowcast
Nowcast.description: Quarterly production forecast (kboe/d), frozen at quarter end, scored vs the company.

baseline.title: Baseline
baseline.description: Naive guess: the company's reported figure for the quarter before.

attributedActual.title: Attributedactual
attributedActual.description: Sodir-attributed production for the quarter, once all three months are in.

PredictionRecord.title: PredictionRecord
PredictionRecord.description: One row of the append-only prediction log (kboe/d), with what happened since.

PriceSeries.title: PriceSeries
PriceSeries.description: Maps onto the frontend's PriceSeries; monthly series are dated the 1st of the month.

ReferenceLevels.title: ReferenceLevels
ReferenceLevels.description: Today's levels, from the explorer's own price data. Needed to turn '$90' into a %.

ScenarioParams.title: ScenarioParams
ScenarioParams.description:
The scenario contract shared with the free-text parser. Names are fixed (snake_case).

Unknown names are rejected (422), so a typo never silently becomes "no change".

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Company the user is looking at; used when the text names none
